rationale: DD gapped up ~6% on high relative volume but has since reversed sharply from the session high of $154.67 down to $146.38, now trading well below VWAP ($149.75) and the 9-EMA ($147.97), indicating strong selling pressure after the gap. The wide bid-ask spread (62 bps) and the stock sitting at only 26.7% of today's range with no clear stabilization pattern in the last few candles make both long and short entries high-risk — a short would be chasing a move already well underway with no news catalyst identified, while a long faces overhead supply from VWAP and the EMA. With existing committed positions and limited remaining loss budget, the risk/reward does not justify a new entry here.
